attackers_goals: An attacker might look for AD CS servers, certificate templates or request certificates. With the wrong setting or loose vulnerable templates or enabled enrollment, the attacker will be able to authenticate as users on the network.
description: A user queried AD CS objects via LDAP.
detector_tags: LDAP Analytics (Server), Active Directory Certificate Services Analytics
investigative_actions: Check if the LDAP search query was allowed for the user (logged on at event time). Investigate the LDAP search query for any suspicious indicators.
name: A user queried AD CS objects via LDAP
required_data: XDR Agent with eXtended Threat Hunting (XTH)
